nphi.title: ZIKAlliance – A global alliance for Zika virus control and prevention
nphi.with: Fundação Oswaldo Cruz (Fiocruz); Instituto Nacional de Salud Pública (INSP Mexico); Norwegian Institute of Public Health (Folkehelseinstituttet); Institut Pasteur; Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social; Universidad Industrial de Santander; Institut Louis Malardé (French Polynesia); Bernhard-Nocht-Institut
nphi.summary: Horizon 2020 multidisciplinary consortium of 50+ partners studying Zika virus natural history, pregnancy outcomes and vector control across Latin America and the Caribbean. NPHIs from Brazil, Mexico, Norway and France took part.

nphi.title: ISCIII–INSP Mexico memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Instituto Nacional de Salud Pública (INSP), Mexico
nphi.summary: A 2025 scientific cooperation framework covering infectious diseases, surveillance, AMR, pandemic preparedness, nutrition, digital health and climate-health, under ISCIII's international health missions programme for Latin America.

nphi.title: North American Preparedness for Animal and Human Pandemics Initiative (NAPAHPI)
nphi.with: US HHS; Mexico Secretaría de Salud (plus agriculture, security and foreign affairs agencies)
nphi.summary: A trilateral One Health framework released in October 2024 for joint preparedness and response to animal and human pandemics. It replaces the 2007 and 2012 North American influenza plans.

nphi.title: CDC Caribbean and Central America Regional Office (CCAMRO)
nphi.with: Caribbean Public Health Agency (CARPHA) and its Reference Laboratory; Council of Ministers of Health of Central America (COMISCA); Gorgas Memorial Institute; SENACYT; INDICASAT
nphi.summary: Launched in 2024 in Panama City, CDC's CCAMRO covers 21 countries, working with CARPHA, COMISCA and Panama's Gorgas Memorial Institute on early warning, surveillance, laboratory strengthening and emergency response capacity.

nphi.title: CDC–Mexico collaboration on antimicrobial resistance surveillance and InDRE laboratory capacity
nphi.with: Secretaría de Salud; Instituto de Diagnóstico y Referencia Epidemiológicos (InDRE)
nphi.summary: Since 2023 CDC Mexico has supported the health ministry in building a national primary-care AMR surveillance system; long-standing work with InDRE built capacity for avian influenza, pertussis and TB, and all 32 state laboratories were…

nphi.title: COVIGEN/RESVIGEN – Regional Genomic Surveillance Network for respiratory viruses
nphi.with: Regional sequencing labs: Fiocruz; ISP Chile; INS Colombia; Inciensa; InDRE; Gorgas; University of the West Indies; US CDC
nphi.summary: PAHO network created in 2020 with eight regional sequencing laboratories, mostly national public health institutes, supporting countries to adopt routine genomic surveillance of SARS-CoV-2, influenza and RSV.

nphi.title: PulseNet Latin America and the Caribbean (PNALC)
nphi.actor: ANLIS Dr. Carlos G. Malbrán – INEI Bacteriology (regional coordinator)
nphi.with: PAHO; US CDC PulseNet International; CARPHA (for its member states); national public health laboratories
nphi.summary: Molecular subtyping network for foodborne disease surveillance founded in 2004, regionally coordinated by INEI-ANLIS Malbrán with PAHO, linking national laboratories of 16 countries plus CARPHA within PulseNet International.

nphi.title: Global Health Security Initiative (GHSI)
nphi.with: Global Health Security Initiative (G7 + Mexico health ministries, European Commission; WHO observer)
nphi.summary: An informal partnership of the G7 countries, Mexico and the European Commission (with WHO as observer) on health security, launched at a ministerial meeting in Ottawa in 2001. Its working groups include a laboratory network, pandemic…

nphi.title: CDC Mexico office (US–Mexico Unit)
nphi.with: Mexican health authorities (not named); US–Mexico Binational Technical Working Group
nphi.summary: CDC established an office in Mexico in 2000, housed in its US–Mexico Unit, to support binational outbreak investigation, surveillance and laboratory capacity (COVID-19, Zika, TB, influenza, measles) and migrant health.

nphi.title: ReLAVRA+ – Latin American and Caribbean Network for Antimicrobial Resistance Surveillance (Malbrán as regional reference)
nphi.actor: ANLIS Dr. Carlos G. Malbrán – INEI (WHO Collaborating Centre for AMR)
nphi.with: PAHO; national reference laboratories of ReLAVRA+ member countries
nphi.summary: PAHO network established in 1996 in which Malbrán's INEI has served as regional reference laboratory, building AMR detection and quality-control capacity in national laboratories; it was designated a WHO Collaborating Centre in 2020.

nphi.title: Multicentric project on territorial health inequalities
nphi.summary: Fiocruz leads a US CDC-funded project on territorial health inequalities in five Latin American countries. IANPHI reports it under its Social and Public Health Inequalities Committee.

nphi.title: InDRE mission to strengthen quality and biorisk management at Bolivia's reference laboratories
nphi.actor: Instituto de Diagnóstico y Referencia Epidemiológicos (InDRE)
nphi.with: INLASA (La Paz); CENETROP (Santa Cruz); PAHO; WHO collaborating centres
nphi.summary: Experts from Mexico's InDRE, with PAHO and WHO collaborating centres, assessed and trained Bolivia's INLASA and CENETROP on biosafety and quality management for influenza and emerging pathogens.

nphi.title: 2022 IANPHI Latin America Annual Meeting – Declaration of Cuernavaca on Health Equity
nphi.actor: Instituto Nacional de Salud Pública (INSP) México
nphi.with: NPHIs of Bolivia, Brazil (Fiocruz), Colombia, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Peru, Suriname; PAHO subregional programmes; ACTO; ORAS-CONHU; SICA/COMISCA
nphi.summary: Latin American NPHIs adopted a declaration on health equity, inequity monitoring, food insecurity, environmental crisis impacts and integrated surveillance.

nphi.title: INSP–University of Arizona public health collaboration agreement
nphi.actor: Instituto Nacional de Salud Pública (INSP) México
nphi.with: Mel and Enid Zuckerman College of Public Health, University of Arizona
nphi.summary: MoU signed in September 2022 formalising about a decade of joint research and student exchange, and opening the way to a comparative health study-abroad programme with INSP.

nphi.title: Multi-country study on quality of maternal health care for Indigenous women (Mexico, Argentina, Peru)
nphi.actor: Instituto Nacional de Salud Pública (INSP) México
nphi.with: Research partners in Argentina and Peru
nphi.summary: INSP-led study with case studies in Mexico, Argentina and Peru on improving the quality of maternal health care for Indigenous women, listed in INSP's 2022 annual work plan.

nphi.title: ECDC–Mexico Ministry of Health memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Ministry of Health of Mexico
nphi.summary: MoU signed in June 2021 between ECDC and Mexico's Ministry of Health on public health cooperation.

nphi.title: IANPHI Latin America Network COVID-19 exchanges
nphi.with: ANLIS (Argentina); INLASA (Bolivia); CARPHA; INS Colombia; INCIENSA (Costa Rica); INSP Mexico; INS Peru; Guyana CMO; Uruguay MoH
nphi.summary: The Fiocruz-chaired Latin American NPHI network held bi-weekly virtual meetings in 2020 to share COVID-19 responses, serology, lab quality control and kit production.

nphi.title: La Red – Mexican Emerging Infectious Disease Clinical Research Network
nphi.actor: US National Institutes of Health – NIAID
nphi.with: Mexican National Institutes of Health and hospitals in La Red
nphi.summary: NIAID-supported clinical research network in Mexico for emerging infectious diseases, listed among NIAID's regional collaborations in the Americas.

nphi.title: CCASAnet – Caribbean, Central and South America network for HIV epidemiology
nphi.with: Clinical and research sites in seven countries
nphi.summary: NIAID-funded regional HIV epidemiology network coordinated by Vanderbilt with clinical research sites in Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Haiti, Honduras, Mexico and Peru.

nphi.title: CDC–PAHO regional course on influenza molecular diagnostics hosted by InDRE
nphi.actor: US CDC (WHO Collaborating Centre for Influenza)
nphi.with: PAHO/WHO; InDRE (host); National Influenza Centres of participating countries
nphi.summary: International training in August 2018 at Mexico's InDRE for National Influenza Centres and laboratories of 11 countries on PCR-based influenza detection, strengthening the regional GISRS network.

nphi.title: Regional Center of Excellence in chronic disease research (planning)
nphi.with: US National Cancer Institute; Harvard School of Public Health; Universidad Hispanoamericana; Instituto de Cancerología (Guatemala); Instituto Nacional de Cancerología (Colombia)
nphi.summary: INSP-led planning of a regional centre of excellence for cancer and diabetes research with the US NCI and Central/South American cancer institutes, including a joint mortality-database study.

nphi.title: ASPR–FUMEC cooperative agreement on pandemic influenza preparedness and IHR in Mexico
nphi.actor: US HHS Office of the Assistant Secretary for Preparedness and Response (ASPR)
nphi.with: US-Mexico Foundation for Science (FUMEC); Secretaría de Salud – CENAPRECE
nphi.summary: Cooperative agreement (2014–2017) working with Mexico's health ministry through CENAPRECE to sustain pandemic influenza and emerging disease preparedness, detection and communication, focused on IHR National Focal Point and…

nphi.title: US–Mexico letter of intent on binational public health events
nphi.actor: US Department of Health and Human Services (with US CDC)
nphi.with: Secretaría de Salud de México
nphi.summary: Letter of intent signed in Geneva in 2012 endorsing technical guidelines for coordinated response to shared epidemiological events along the border, beyond IHR obligations, and creating a binational working group to draft protocols.

nphi.title: NHRC–InDRE annual laboratory exchange and training
nphi.with: Instituto de Diagnóstico y Referencia Epidemiológicos (InDRE); CDC Border Infectious Disease Surveillance (BIDS)
nphi.summary: Annual exchange begun after the 2009 influenza pandemic in which InDRE scientists train at NHRC in San Diego in molecular biology, microbiology, culture, serology, quality control and laboratory safety.

nphi.title: NML laboratory testing support to Mexico during the 2009 H1N1 outbreak
nphi.with: Secretaría de Salud (Mexico); National Microbiology Laboratory (NML)
nphi.summary: At Mexico's request, PHAC's National Microbiology Laboratory tested about 200 respiratory specimens from Mexican patients in April 2009 and helped identify the new H1N1 virus. Canada later supplied Mexico with 5 million H1N1 vaccine doses.

nphi.title: Trilateral North American MoU on mutual assistance in public health emergencies
nphi.with: US Department of Health and Human Services; Secretaría de Salud de México
nphi.summary: MoU signed in November 2007 committing Canada, the US and Mexico to mutual assistance in public health emergencies, cross-border surveillance cooperation, laboratory information and reagent sharing, joint exercises and sharing of…

nphi.title: Mexico Field Epidemiology Training Program
nphi.with: Secretaría de Salud – Dirección General de Epidemiología
nphi.summary: Mexico's FETP, run by the federal health ministry's epidemiology directorate, was launched with CDC support in 1984, one of the earliest CDC-supported FETPs after Thailand and Indonesia.

calendar.title: Mexico — midterm legislative and state elections
